name: zinterp_context_register_scroll_always_node
description: zInterp_Context::RegisterScrollAlwaysNode configures texture-world scrolling and either installs the default render callback directly or queues the node behind the scroll-always driver.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zInterp parser/runtime source-cluster pass.

The native smoke covers the direct callback path and the existing-driver queue path. Lazy driver-node creation is backed by Binary Ninja call-order evidence and remains a source-cluster tier S pass item.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4c58e0 validates the null node and null display-instance returns, gwNodeGetUserData display-instance fetch, zModel::SetDiTextureWorldPerMeter(di, 1, textureWorldPerMeter, textureWorldAxis), direct DefaultRenderAction installation when the driver flag is false, lazy ScrollAlways driver-node creation/name/context setup, tail insertion of a 12-byte zInterp_LinkNode, payload storage, count increment, and true return.
The native smoke verifies null guards, texture-world metadata update, direct callback installation, existing-driver list tail insertion, payload storage, and scrollAlwaysListCount update.
